headline: Google teases Fitbit Edge wearable ahead of expected reveal
summary: Google is teasing an unannounced wearable called Fitbit Edge, posting on X a picture of the device with a caption referencing a health-focused date. Outlets say Google has effectively confirmed the product's existence ahead of an expected reveal around October 12.

claims.statement: Google is teasing the reveal of a rumored new wearable called 'Fitbit Edge,' expected around October 12.

sources.quote: Google teases Fitbit Edge launch next week
Google teases its new 'Fitbit Edge' wearable ahead of an October 12 reveal
Google has seemingly confirmed the rumored "Fitbit Edge" with social media posts teasing a new wearable coming October 12.

claims.statement: Google posted a picture of the device on X with a caption referencing a health-focused date of 10.12.26.

sources.quote: In a post on X, Google posted a picture of what appears to be the side of the fitness tracker
